pro_course_detail.description:
To enhance your speaking ability with the help of Daily activity topics.

Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

pro_course_detail.title: Primary/Middle/High School/College English
pro_course_detail.description:
Primary School English

It includes basic concepts in English needed by the young English learners. New words and phrases will be introduced and applied by the students through drills in reading, writing, speaking and listening. Teaching tools such as manipulatives will be utilized throughout the lessons. Sentence construction will be a key goal in the lessons.

Middle/High School English

Higher concepts in Science, Math, and Social Studies will be introduced in the lessons to make the students be familiarized with those concepts in the English language. Comprehension and formal writing using the correct grammar are the essential parts of the lessons, given in a non-intimidating way by the teacher. Oral and Written English are given equal importance in the lessons so as to prepare the young students for English examinations and recitations.

College English

Intensive concepts in various fields related to the course major of the students will be tackled. There will be activities that can encourage the students to be confident in speaking and writing in English. There will be more practical exercises in the lessons which can prepare the students for in-depth English tests. Oral and written English are also give equal importance.

pro_course_detail.description:
Conversational/Travel English

This course will enable the students to learn essential words and expressions that they can use in real life settings, especially during their travels. The lessons will be practical as more time will be given for the students to practice the expressions that they have learned.

Free Talk English

This type of class is highly encouraged for middle and higher level students to practice their oral English and achieve English fluency. Listening and speaking skills are improved through spontaneous conversations depending on the topic that the student might want to tackle. Varied topics may be discussed including trending news and subjects that the students are interested in.
